decisions.reason: The safety shoe line is core to the firm's identity and was moved up to its own page in 2024, signalling growing visible commitment that management would be reluctant to reverse.
The comfort insole is only mentioned and involved little investment, so dropping it would cost little, but it still fits the foot-care accessory range and shows no clear failure.
The supportive insole is a low-commitment accessory that could be consolidated into the featured insole line, yet without clear evidence of failure it is likely retained for now.
The ergonomic series has had its own page since launch and embodies the announced innovation direction, so dropping it would expose a visible strategic bet as a mistake.

Firefighter boots required certification and production investment and were upgraded to their own page in 2024, so commitment is rising and early slow results can be attributed to long public procurement cycles.

The moulded FIT Insole is featured on the home page, tied to the firm's foot-measurement service, and promoted with a public sports-club partnership, making it highly visible and very unlikely to be dropped.
